title: Nether Stomach Noises
description: My friend told me they didn't find the Nether waste's sound effects to be gross sounding, so I upped the ante.
body:
This is the Nether Stomach Noises resource pack. In it, it replaces some Nether Noises with Stomach Noises. You are warned.

Why? Because my friend told me he didn't find the Nether to be as scary or gross as I found it, and so I wanted him to feel it too.

Credits? A few of the sound samples are from random contributors on pixabay, while the majority of them came from SamanthaCastleberry who I believe makes content of questionable purposes, but she did provide great disturbing stomach noises.

Important notes? It only affects the Nether Wastes. So if you're in the woods, or basalt, or soul sands, you don't need to hear any crazy noises. You only hear it in the limbo between...
